media.title: Joséphine Baker — Studio Harcourt, 1940
media.description: Joséphine Baker photographed by Studio Harcourt in 1940. She recorded “J’ai un message pour toi”, written by Kaper and Jurmann.
media.altText: Black-and-white studio portrait of Joséphine Baker.
media.publicCaption: Joséphine Baker photographed by Studio Harcourt in 1940. She recorded “J’ai un message pour toi”, written by Kaper and Jurmann.
media.publicCreditLine: Studio Harcourt, 1940; Médiathèque du patrimoine et de la photographie, negative U500008NC; digital image via Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in France: Studio Harcourt photographs are treated as collective works, whose term runs seventy years from publication and expired in 2010, and Wikimedia Commons holds archived permission documentation for the file. The United States position differs: the French term was still running on 1 January 1996, so the URAA restored United States copyright. A reduced-resolution reproduction (420 × 588 px, from 540 × 756 px) is used for scholarly identification of a documented performer of a Kaper song.

contributions.scopeNote: Sang the song; the recording is published on the Jube Pops compilation Musical Moments to Remember: Joséphine Baker, which does not identify the original disc.
